name: Progress ring infographic
what: An upright infographic on a soft tile-grid page: a headline comes in word by word over a marker bar, a short text follows word by word, then a progress ring fades in at the right with its number inside.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f9-f55 the headline comes in word by word, each word fading in as the one before finishes; f16-f26 the marker bar fades in behind it; f61-f177 the text under it comes in word by word (quick at first, slowing to a soft finish); f175-f184 the ring fades in already drawn up to its number; f189-f232 the number fades in inside it; then it holds to the end

tracks.what: the headline's words fade in one after another
